notes:
{週|しゅう} means "week" and is used both as a noun and counter.

AS A COUNTER:
- 1{週|しゅう} (one week)
- 2{週|しゅう} (two weeks)
- ⟦{何週|なんしゅう}→何週：noentry⟧ (how many weeks)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧ (this week)
- ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧ (next week)
- ⟦{先週|せんしゅう}→先週：00752_senshuu⟧ (last week)
- ⟦{再来週|さらいしゅう}→再来週：01416_saraishuu⟧ (week after next)
- ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧ (every week)
- ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧ (weekend)
- ⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧ (week, week-long period)
- ⟦{週刊|しゅうかん}→週刊：14373_shuukan⟧ (weekly publication)

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- 1⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧ (one week - as duration)
- 2⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧ (two weeks)
